name: Trick test: real title company reads out wire instructions (must not block)

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: hi margaret it's dana from golden gate title about your closing on friday

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh yes, the little house on Elm Street. Is everything alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: everything is on schedule i just wanted to go over the wire instructions in your closing packet

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me find my pen. Okay, go ahead, slowly please.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Five, six, seven, three, four, zero, one, two, two.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Two, two, one, zero, four, four, six, one. Got it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: please call our office number on your documents to confirm them before you send anything there's no rush

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: That's very kind of you, dear. I'll have my son call. Goodbye now.
